'''2019 NAC Nate Louderback LS Combat Preparedness''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nate Louderback]] at [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nate Louderback]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 North American Continental Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness Louderback LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804025510/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/ Internet Archive]
